notes: Modified cash basis school district (FY ended 2025-08-31). Statement values from the Statement of Receipts, Disbursements and Changes in Fund Balances - Governmental Funds, Total Governmental Funds column (pp5-6); beginning 11,118,766 = fund balances beginning (p6), ending 15,509,314 = fund balances ending (p6) = Statement of Net Position (p1) = cash + cash at County Treasurer; investments not reported separately. All funds, including the Nutrition Fund, are treated as governmental because the statement reports them as governmental funds; no business-type funds, so business_type is null. Balance sheet from the Statement of Net Position (p1), which has no liabilities. 'Balance carried forward' lines on p5/p6 are carry-forward subtotals, not recorded. Nonrevenue receipts 987,276 split using the fund schedules (insurance adjustments, sale/disposal of property, other, QCPUF penalties). Other local receipts 81,991 kept as one line (charges for services dominant: student fees 33,587 + community service 20,586). Detail: used the per-fund budget-to-actual schedules (pp9-22) for all ten funds; the combining schedule for General Fund components (pp7-8) is summarized by those schedules and is not recorded separately (no double counting). General Fund schedule (pp9-13) covers the General component only (29,043,266 receipts excl. loan); Depreciation, Employee Benefit and Cooperative have separate schedules. General Fund detail lines with zero actual and budget-only lines (e.g. 2110 attendance 1,450,000, 4708/4709 Medicaid, Reappropriated Funds 1,924,081) are omitted; other schedules omit zero-actual lines too. Interfund loan 2,000,000 (General in, QCPUF out) recorded as other financing within printed totals. General Fund transfers out 700,000 on p13 is inside total disbursements and recorded as other financing. Hidden transfer: the Reclassifications column on p8 removes 124,293 (Employee Benefit 64,293 + Cooperative 60,000 transfers from General) from instruction/state categorical/federal program spending; recorded as a contra expenditure line plus a transfer out in other financing (review). General Fund non-instructional (3300/3400), state categorical and federal program lines are categorized as instruction because the statement's reclassification column counts them there. Student Fee Fund shows negative support services spending (247) as printed. Activities Fund spending labelled central services; statement shows other governmental funds Instruction 681,584 = Activities 681,831 + Student Fee (247). Read pages 1-22 of 22.
